description: Stage 1 compares complete KRR pipelines. Each method owns landmark/eigenspace/model setup and solving; prediction is reported separately. Successful time-quality results are retained regardless of the descriptive 1% reference-equivalence label.

target_selection.rule: Select the largest N with all six declared pipeline rows present, successful Nystrom/EFGP rows, full-eig/ours inside the every-repeat broad absolute RMSE/R2 usability range, and standard EFGP-CG median iterations in [3000,6000]. The 1% full-eig reference-equivalence label is descriptive only and never suppresses raw speedups. An RPCholesky resource_limit row is a prospectively allowed scalability outcome and does not block solver-target selection; it never receives a speedup. Equal-N ties use the declared Winnebago-then-Synthetic priority. If no case qualifies, fail closed rather than substitute a post-hoc target.

stage2_fixed_ab.inverse_policy: Stage-2 explicit active-inverse may use the 16384 cap, while default keeps the frozen 1024 deployment threshold and therefore remains the Stage-1 active-eig route.

scale_10m_300m.description: Primary end-to-end KRR scale comparison. Resource-limit rows remain visible and are never replaced by pilot or subsampled algorithms.

robustness_at_selected_target.description: Prospectively materialized only after target selection. Lambda, lengthscale, and dataset axes freeze the selected historical-transfer top-k as an upper bound and explicitly allow deterministic shortening only when its centered box exceeds the same frozen box budget; every actual top-k, box size, and rule is recorded. The box-budget axis is separately labelled budget-adaptive score selection. Neither path uses timing or accuracy to choose parameters.
